blocks.text: This is a roundup of the top stories from and about Germany on Wednesday, September 30, 2026:
Cabinet debates care reform after uncertainty

The German Cabinet is to discuss the draft bill put forward by Health Minister Carsten Linnemann to reform the care system after much heated debate between the coalition partners, the Federal Press Office in Berlin has said.

The reform proposals have highlighted divisions between the bloc of conservative Christian Democrats (CDU) with Bavarian sister party the Christian Social Union (CSU), and junior coalition partner the center-left Social Democrats (SPD).
Those divisions made it uncertain up to the last moment whether Wednesday's meeting was to take place.
